protocol.arms: Local-minus-outer change in log luma residual energy, luma/chroma regression coupling, or log chroma residual energy after separately regressing each chroma axis on luma. Values use RGB-decoder YCrCb conversion and do not establish sensor identity.
protocol.decision: Per arm, the larger of 0.03 and the third-largest positive ordinary development score. Flag when strictly larger. Correct range uses native time IoU at least 0.50.
protocol.gate: At least four source-event-aligned redraws localized across three groups, at least 70% coverage in each main class, at most two ordinary flags, and zero untouched, recompression or cut flags. Color arms must also exceed the luma comparator's useful locations without extra ordinary flags. No claim of generator-independent validation.
protocol.input: One upright short upload, native RGB pixels, verified source picture clock and observed single-face geometry. No audio, earlier copy, edit mask or supplied range enters measurement.
protocol.new_controls: First committed original from each of 12 additional speaker groups. Add whole-picture H.264 4:2:0 CRF 28 and ordinary local chroma denoising in the central 16 pictures. Denoising uses a mouth-centered 26 by 15 elliptical feather and 35% of a 1.3-native-pixel chroma blur with two-picture end ramps. Preserve every original timestamp. These controls are held, never used to choose the points.
protocol.patches: Eight sectors of 5 by 5 sample points around two mouth-centered elliptical rails, at 1.0 and 1.7 times the 15 by 8 normalized eye-unit radii. Gaussian band pass at 0.75 and 1.9 native pixels. Neighbor rails require luma residual RMS of at least 0.25 and within a factor of 3.
protocol.range: Scan 8, 12, 16 and 20 pictures with five-picture flanks in one observed shot. Each sector requires at least 80% observed pictures per window, with a same-direction change against each flank. At least three consistent sectors. Keep one strongest range, with separate arms and no selection using held labels.
